title: Smart India Hackathon
description: A national-level hackathon bringing multidisciplinary teams together to solve real public-sector challenges. Build a working prototype and present it to domain experts.

title: Hardware + AI Innovation Challenge
description: Design an innovative solution that combines connected hardware with practical artificial intelligence. Teams will demonstrate their prototype and explain its real-world impact.

title: GreenTech Startup Pitch Cup
description: Pitch a scalable startup idea that addresses an environmental challenge through technology. Finalists receive expert feedback and present to an investor panel.

title: Open Source Smart Farm Platform
description: Contribute to an open-source platform that helps small farms monitor resources and coordinate data. Collaborate on an accessible first release for growers.
